Animal travel moves smoothly when the desk keeps the steps clear and calm.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: this section sets the check-in, handoff, and reporting rules for companion animal travel at Aurelia Skyways.

For boarding, use FM-597 before the animal leaves the desk. Check the carrier, tags, and traveler details at the same time, and keep the tone warm and steady while you brief the traveler on the next step. The desk handles questions with patience, but do not promise outcomes that are outside the posted travel rules.

For incident reporting, the Claim Adjudicator oversees the process from first note to final record. Log any delay, injury, refusal, or container problem right away, and keep the entry factual, short, and complete. If the cabin team sends a report during flight, match it to the desk file before you close the case.

When a traveler arrives with a pet, confirm the name on the booking, inspect the carrier latches, and make sure the animal has water and a secure space. If the animal appears distressed, pause the handoff and alert the on-duty supervisor before the flight team takes over. Keep all paperwork with the traveler packet and store copies in the desk file.

If Samuel Svensson, Nora Khan, or any other traveler asks for help, answer in plain language and stay consistent with the travel rules. Keep a direct line with the cabin team so animal checks stay coordinated from departure to arrival. If a record looks incomplete, return it to the desk owner for correction before release.

If anything is unclear, contact the shift lead or the duty supervisor at once.
